title: Getting Started with GSD
description: Learn the core GSD workflow from project initialization to phase execution

steps.title: Initialize Your Project
steps.description: Every GSD project starts with initialization. This creates the .planning directory with your config.
steps.what_happens: GSD will ask you questions about your project and create a structured configuration in .planning/config.json
common_mistakes: Running this in the wrong directory
Running it when project is already initialized
steps.tip: Make sure you're in your project's git root directory first!

steps.title: Research Your Project
steps.description: Before planning, do research to understand your domain and technical requirements.
steps.what_happens: GSD will research your project domain and create a RESEARCH.md file with findings
common_mistakes: Skipping research and going straight to planning
steps.tip: Good research leads to better plans and fewer surprises during execution.

steps.title: Create Your Roadmap
steps.description: Generate a structured phase-based roadmap from your research.
steps.what_happens: GSD creates a ROADMAP.md with phases, milestones, and success criteria
common_mistakes: Creating a roadmap without research first
steps.tip: The roadmap breaks your project into manageable phases.

steps.title: Discuss Phase 1
steps.description: Talk through the requirements and goals for your first phase.
steps.what_happens: Interactive discussion about phase scope, technical approach, and success criteria
common_mistakes: Skipping discussion and going straight to planning
steps.tip: Discussion ensures Claude understands exactly what you want to build.

steps.title: Plan Phase 1
steps.description: Generate a detailed implementation plan with tasks and acceptance criteria.
steps.what_happens: Creates PLAN.md with step-by-step implementation tasks
common_mistakes: Not reviewing the plan before executing
steps.tip: Review the plan carefully — you can ask for changes before executing.

steps.title: Execute Phase 1
steps.description: Start the actual implementation following your plan.
steps.what_happens: GSD works through each task in your plan, writing code and creating files
common_mistakes: Not having a clean git state first
steps.tip: Commit any uncommitted changes before executing a phase.

steps.title: Verify Phase 1
steps.description: Verify all artifacts and acceptance criteria are met.
steps.what_happens: GSD checks each artifact exists and meets criteria, reports pass/fail
common_mistakes: Skipping verification and moving to the next phase
steps.tip: Verification catches issues early before they compound in later phases.

title: Configuring Your Preferences
description: Set up your personal GSD configuration for optimal workflow

steps.title: Open Preferences
steps.description: Navigate to the Preferences page to configure your GSD settings.
steps.what_happens: The preferences page shows all configurable options with descriptions
steps.tip: Your preferences are saved to .planning/config.json in your project.

steps.title: Choose Your Model Profile
steps.description: Select quality, balanced, or budget profile based on your needs.
steps.what_happens: Sets the default Claude model tier for GSD commands
steps.tip: Balanced mode works great for most development tasks.
